Container.Name: myenergi-monitor
Container.Overview: Live myenergi device values with CT load charts. Records readings continuously and draws Harvi link reports for any date range. Set an app password to require a login.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Recorded readings (readings.db), uploaded logs, CT choices and the sign-in key

Config.Name: Ember email
Config.Description: Optional: your EPH Ember app login, to show the hot water tank temperature from the heating system's probe (read-only)

Config.Name: Ember password
Config.Description: Optional: your EPH Ember app password

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Password for the web page (leave blank for no login). Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Harvi names
Config.Description: Optional: serial=name,serial=name (a name containing 'grid' marks the grid Harvi)

Config.Name: Grid Harvi serial
Config.Description: Optional: default grid Harvi on the Harvi health page

Config.Name: Behind proxy
Config.Description: 1 when served through a reverse proxy (nginx) doing HTTPS; 0 when accessed directly

Config.Name: Poll seconds
Config.Description: How often the background recorder polls the API

Config.Name: Keep raw readings (days)
Config.Description: Raw device readings (Live values, Harvi health; about 1.9 MB per day) older than this are deleted. Energy and car history is kept indefinitely (about 0.3 MB per day)

Config.Name: Backfill history from
Config.Description: How far back to fetch the hub's minute-by-minute history (for the Car tab): a date such as 2026-03-24 (e.g. when the car charger was installed) or a number of days

Config.Name: Record
Config.Description: 1 = record readings continuously for the Harvi health and Home energy pages; 0 = off

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users)
